records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Consolidated total revenues in the second quarter of 2022 increased $36.1 million, or 25%, from the second quarter of 2021.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Backlog reported by our Offshore/Manufactured Products segment increased to $241 million as of June 30, 2022 from $214 million as of June 30, 2021.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Our reported results of operations reflect the negative impact of the global response to the COVID-19 pandemic, ongoing uncertainties related to future crude oil demand and supply and, to a lesser extent, supply chain disruptions.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The higher commodity price environment was driven by declines in crude oil supplies, concerns over sanctions resulting from the Russian invasion of Ukraine on February 24, 2022, increased demand as the global effects of the COVID-19 pandemic have moderated and slower crude oil production growth due to reduced investments by operators globally.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Our consolidated operating loss was $1.1 million in the second quarter of 2022.
